**Note:** You can use this file as you 'working document' where you can try out various investigation ideas and keep notes about your findings. How you use and structure this file is up to you. It is recommended that you keep notes about what you are investigating and what you find as this will make the process of creating your presentation and report easier. Please note that you *do not* need to submit this file as part of your group project.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load-lib, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(janitor)
library(dbplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(ggcube)
library(geometry)
library(gganimate)
library(plotly)
# Add any other libraries here


```

```{r load-data}
# load your data 

df = read.csv("data/SeoulBikeData.csv", fileEncoding = "latin1") %>% clean_names() %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y"))

```

```{r summary data here}
df_seasons_mean <- df %>% 
  group_by(seasons) %>% 
  summarise(mean_hourly_bike_count = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm= TRUE))

df_date_mean <- df %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  summarise(mean_hourly_bike_count = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm= TRUE))

df_hour_mean <- df %>% 
  group_by(hour) %>% 
  summarise(mean_hourly_bike_count = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm= TRUE))


df_temp_mean <- df %>% 
  mutate(temp_grp = factor(
    case_when(
      temperature_c <= -10 ~ "Extremely low",
      temperature_c >= -10 & temperature_c < 0 ~ "Very low",
      temperature_c >= 0 & temperature_c < 10 ~ "Low",
      temperature_c >= 10 & temperature_c < 20 ~ "Mid",
      temperature_c >= 20 & temperature_c < 30 ~ "High",
      temperature_c >= 30 & temperature_c < 40 ~ "Very high",
      TRUE ~ "Extremely high" 
      ), 
    level = c("Extremely low", 
              "Very low", 
              "Low", 
              "Mid", 
              "High", 
              "Very high", 
              "Extremely high"))) %>% 
  group_by(temp_grp) %>% 
  summarise(mean_bike_count = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm= TRUE))

```

```{r trial1}

#dont include
trialdf1 = df %>% select(-functioning_day, -holiday) %>% group_by(hour, seasons) %>% 
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

trialdf2 = df %>% select(-functioning_day, -holiday) %>% group_by(hour, seasons) %>% 
  summarise(
    m = mean(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

coeff = 0.01

ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = trialdf1, aes(x = hour, y = Mean), stat = "identity", alpha = 0.7, fill = "lightblue") +
  geom_point(data = trialdf2, aes(x = hour, y = m/coeff), size = 2, colour = "grey") +
  facet_wrap(~ seasons) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Mean Rented Bike Count",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*coeff, name="Mean Temperature (C)")
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "lightblue", size=13),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "grey", size=13)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hour",
    title = "Effect Temperature has on Rented Bike Count (by hours of the day)"
  ) 


```

```{r trial2}
#dont include
trialdf3 = df %>% select(-functioning_day, -holiday) %>% group_by(hour, seasons) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_bike_count = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

trialdf4 = df %>% select(-functioning_day, -holiday) %>% group_by(hour, seasons) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_temperature = mean(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
trialdf5 <- inner_join(trialdf3, trialdf4, by = c("seasons", "hour")) 
ggplot(data = trialdf5, 
       mapping = aes(x = mean_bike_count, y = mean_temperature, colour = seasons)) +
geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~ seasons) +
labs(title = "Correlation Between Temperature and Bike Demand",
       x = "Mean Number of Bikes Demanded", 
       y = "Mean Temperature (°C)",
     colour= "Seasons")


```

```{r trial3}
#added to report
#Correlation between Temperature and Bike Demand

#Lizzy in report

trialdf6 <- df %>% 
  select(date, rented_bike_count, temperature_c, seasons) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(day_bike_count = sum(rented_bike_count), 
            mean_day_temp_c = mean(temperature_c))


coeff <- 0.001

ggplot(trialdf6, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = day_bike_count), 
             colour = "tomato", size = 0.6) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(y = day_bike_count), se = FALSE, 
              colour = "tomato", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_day_temp_c/ coeff), 
             colour = "cornflowerblue", size = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(aes(y = mean_day_temp_c/ coeff), se = FALSE, 
              colour = "cornflowerblue", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       title = "Correlation Between Number of Rented Bikes and Temperature") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of Rented Bikes",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*coeff, name="Temperature (in degrees celsius)")
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "tomato", size = 13),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "cornflowerblue", size = 13)
  ) 

trialdf6 %>% summarise(Correlation = cor(day_bike_count, mean_day_temp_c))

```

```{r trial 15 - model 1}
#(MODEL-TEMPERATURE)

linear_reg()%>%
  set_engine("lm") %>%
   fit(day_bike_count ~ mean_day_temp_c, data = trialdf14) %>%
  tidy()
```

```{r trial 16 - model 1 assessment}
#(MODEL- TEMPERATURE)
bike_temp_fit <- linear_reg() %>% 
  set_engine("lm") %>%
   fit(day_bike_count ~ mean_day_temp_c, data = trialdf14)

 bike_temp_fit_aug <- augment(bike_temp_fit$fit)

ggplot(bike_temp_fit_aug, mapping = aes(x = .fitted, y = .resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray", lty = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Predicted bike demand", y = "Residuals", title = "Residuals for Predicted Bike Demand from Mean Daily Temperature") +
  theme_bw()

glance(bike_temp_fit)
```


```{r trial 17 - model 2}
#INCLUDE (model-all)
#joining data frames
bike_sun_df <- trialdf15 %>%
  group_by(date, hours_of_sunlight) %>%
  summarise(day_bike_count = sum(rented_bike_count))

trialdf18 <- left_join(trialdf14, trialdf8, by = c("date", "day_bike_count"))
  daily_weather_bike <- left_join(trialdf18, bike_sun_df, by  = c("date", "day_bike_count"))

#setting seed and splitting data    
  set.seed(1234)
  daily_weather_bike_split <- initial_split(daily_weather_bike)
  
  dwb_train <- training(daily_weather_bike_split)
  dim(dwb_train)
  
  dwb_test <- testing(daily_weather_bike_split)
  dim(dwb_test)

#specifying model
dwb_model <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm")
dwb_model

#building recipe
dwb_rec <- recipe(day_bike_count ~ mean_day_temp_c + hours_of_sunlight, data = dwb_train)

#workflow
dwb_wflow <- workflow() %>% 
  add_model(dwb_model) %>%
   add_recipe(dwb_rec)
dwb_wflow

#fitting
dwb_fit <- dwb_wflow %>% 
  fit(data = dwb_train)

dwb_fit
```


```{r trail 17.5}

dwb_rec2 <- recipe(day_bike_count ~ mean_day_temp_c + hours_of_sunlight + mean_day_humidity, data = dwb_train)

#workflow
dwb_wflow2 <- workflow() %>% 
  add_model(dwb_model) %>%
   add_recipe(dwb_rec2)
dwb_wflow2

#fitting
dwb_fit2 <- dwb_wflow2 %>% 
  fit(data = dwb_train)


dwb_train_pred2 <- predict(dwb_fit2, dwb_train)%>%
bind_cols(dwb_train %>% select(date, day_bike_count))


#calculating r squared for training data 
rsq(dwb_train_pred2, truth = day_bike_count, estimate = .pred)

dwb_test_pred2 <- predict(dwb_fit2, dwb_test)%>%
bind_cols(dwb_test%>% select(date, day_bike_count))


#calculating r squared for testing data 
rsq(dwb_test_pred2, truth = day_bike_count, estimate = .pred)


r2 <- rsq(dwb_train_pred2, truth = day_bike_count, estimate = .pred)$.estimate

n <- nrow(dwb_train_pred2)
p <- 2

adj_r2 <- 1 - (1 - r2) * (n - 1) / (n - p - 1)

adj_r2

r2 <- rsq(dwb_test_pred2, truth = day_bike_count, estimate = .pred)$.estimate

n <- nrow(dwb_test_pred2)
p <- 2

adj_r2 <- 1 - (1 - r2) * (n - 1) / (n - p - 1)

adj_r2



```

```{r trial 19 - model 3 }
ggplot(bike_humid_fit_aug, mapping = aes(x = .fitted, y = .resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray", lty = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Predicted bike demand", y = "Residuals", title = "Residuals for Predicted Bike Demand from Mean Daily Humidity") +
  theme_bw()

glance(bike_humid_fit)
```

```{r }

df_bike_cat <- df %>% 
  mutate(bike_grp = factor(
    case_when(
      rented_bike_count <= 400 ~ "0-400",
      rented_bike_count <= 800 ~ "401-800",
      rented_bike_count <= 1200 ~ "801-1200",
      rented_bike_count <= 1600 ~ "1201-1600",
      rented_bike_count <= 2000 ~ "1601-2000",
      rented_bike_count <= 2400 ~ "2001-2400",
      rented_bike_count > 2400 ~ "Greater than 2400"
    ),
    levels = c("0-400",
               "401-800",
               "801-1200",
               "1201-1600",
               "1601-2000",
               "2001-2400",
               "Greater than 2400"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))

set.seed(1234)

bike_split <- initial_split(df_bike_cat)
bike_train <- training(bike_split)
bike_test <- testing(bike_split)

bike_rec <- recipe(bike_grp ~ temperature_c, 
                   data = bike_train)

bike_mod <- multinom_reg() %>% 
  set_engine("nnet") 

bike_wflow <- workflow() %>% 
  add_model(bike_mod) %>% 
  add_recipe(bike_rec)

bike_fit <- bike_wflow %>% 
  fit(data = bike_train)

bike_pred <- predict(bike_fit, bike_test, type = "prob") %>% 
  bind_cols(predict(bike_fit, bike_test, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(bike_test %>% select(bike_grp, temperature_c))


bike_pred %>%
  roc_auc(
    truth = bike_grp,
    `.pred_0-400`,
    `.pred_401-800`,
    `.pred_801-1200`,
    `.pred_1201-1600`,
    `.pred_1601-2000`,
    `.pred_2001-2400`,
    `.pred_Greater than 2400`,
    estimator = "hand_till"
  )

bike_pred %>%
  roc_curve(
    truth = bike_grp,
    `.pred_0-400`,
    `.pred_401-800`,
    `.pred_801-1200`,
    `.pred_1201-1600`,
    `.pred_1601-2000`,
    `.pred_2001-2400`,
    `.pred_Greater than 2400`,
    estimator = "hand_till"
  ) %>%
  autoplot()



```
